title: fedcraft
description: A large bit of everything, minecraft 1.21
body:
# Fedcraft

## A kitchen-sink modpack built around Create.

### What's in it
Most of the major Create addons including Aeronautics, Big Cannons, New Age, Numismatics, Copycats+, Central Kitchen and more. Tech from Mekanism, Immersive Engineering and Industrial Foregoing. Refined Storage for logistics. Iron's Spells for magic. 

Simply Swords and Combat Roll for combat.

Worldgen is overhauled with Terralith, Tectonic and Biolith. Structures from Towns and Towers, When Dungeons Arise, Dungeons and Taverns, Incendium and the full YUNG's suite. Food and farming covered by Farmer's Delight, Brewin' and Chewin', Pam's HarvestCraft and the Let's Do addons.

### Why download it
One pack covering tech, magic, exploration and Create contraptions without having to put it together yourself.

### Before you install
Minecraft 1.21, Java 21
Forge with Sinytra Connector
10GB RAM minimum
Runs on Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix and FerriteCore so it holds up on a server
